title: Reading the Greeting — One Piece at a Time
label: ch:zh-components
canDo: I can write each component the greeting's two characters are built from, and then assemble both characters from those pieces rather than recalling them as whole shapes.

payoff.summary: The second assembly, built from two components the reader wrote individually a moment earlier — and a caution that the memorable story about why it means what it means is a story, not a source.
